summary.text: Rhonda Butler is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 38 (Evangeline and Rapides parishes), and was elected in 2019, according to the official House member page. Rhonda Butler chairs the Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development Committee.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Rhonda Butler's occupation as Owner, Butler & Company Tree and Storm Recover; Owner, Gobble Gully Paint Ball.
It lists education as Cosmetology; Leadership and Training; Business Management.

The page lists committee assignments including Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development (chair), Health and Welfare, the Joint Medicaid Oversight Committee, the House Select Committee on Women and Children and the Special Committee on Military and Veterans Affairs, and caucus affiliations including the Acadiana Delegation, the Central Louisiana Delegation Caucus, the Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus, the Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation and the Louisiana Rural Caucus.
